clues: This city sits in the north of Tasmania, in Australia. Two Esk rivers meet here and join to form the River Tamar.
This city has a sea-side climate with four clear seasons. In summer it is much warmer than the south of the island.
Europeans settled here in March 1806. It is one of the oldest cities in Australia, and many old buildings still stand.
This city was the first in Australia to be lit by hydro power. No city in the land had such lights before it.
Only Hobart has more folks in Tasmania. This city comes next as the isle's clear second city.
